channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: A Google VP explains why ads make sense in AI search but not Gemini — yet
item.description: Ads in AI Overviews are already performing at "about the same rate" as traditional search ads, according to Google's VP of global ads, Dan Taylor.

item.title: Google is leaning on its app empire to give Gemini an edge with 'Personal Intelligence'
item.description: The Gemini AI chatbot can now reason across Google apps including Gmail, Photos and YouTube, offering something OpenAI and Anthropic don't have.

item.title: Brands that skimp on social media marketing do so at their own peril
item.description: Social media drove more purchases than ever on US retail sites in November and December, according to a new report from Adobe.

item.title: Gwyneth Paltrow says becoming an empty nester felt like 'a divorce'
item.description: Gwyneth Paltrow said she "really struggled" when her kids, Apple Martin, 21, and Moses Martin, 19, flew the nest.

item.title: I moved to Spain over a decade ago and visit the Bay Area yearly. After a few weeks in California, I remember why I stay abroad.
item.description: After more than a decade living in Spain, visiting the US now brings reverse culture shock, from car dependency and traffic to high costs and busy lives.

item.title: Walmart's head of AI reveals the key difference between its shopping deals with Google Gemini and ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI broke new ground when it enabled shopping within ChatGPT, but Walmart's head of AI said the retailer's new Google Gemini deal goes further.

item.title: Not saving up for a home? Tell us what you're spending your money on instead.
item.description: If you're not saving up for homeownership, Business Insider would like to know what you're spending your money on instead.

item.title: Citi's CEO Jane Fraser warns staff in memo: old habits are out, and performance is in
item.description: Citi's CEO pledged to save billions by cutting jobs. A new memo and statements by the bank's top brass shed light on how that will play out in 2026.

item.title: Inside Saks Fifth Avenue's fight for its life: How 12 months of upheaval left the luxury icon in bankruptcy
item.description: Saks filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after a year of missed payments, vendor pullbacks, and a rescue plan gone awry. Here's how the crisis unfolded.

item.title: Microsoft Copilot blamed by UK police for an error that led to a controversial soccer fan ban
item.description: Officials ultimately banned fans of Maccabi Tel Aviv from attending a November match, a decision that has sparked immense criticism.
